# CodeHost — Full Technical & LLM Reference

> Comprehensive platform specification, pricing, REST API reference, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server schemas for CodeHost (`https://code-host.online`).

## 1. Platform Capabilities & Architecture
CodeHost is an automated Platform as a Service (PaaS) running isolated Docker workloads behind an edge reverse proxy with automated Let's Encrypt TLS termination.

- **Web App**: https://code-host.online
- **Control Plane API**: https://api.code-host.online
- **MCP Server**: https://api.code-host.online/mcp
- **Documentation**: https://code-host.online/docs
- **Public Stats**: https://api.code-host.online/stats/public
- **System Health**: https://code-host.online/status

### Isolation & Runtime Guarantees
- Workloads run in isolated Docker containers on the `proxy` bridge network with strict cgroup Memory, MemorySwap, CPU (`NanoCpus`), and PIDs limits (`PidsLimit: 128`, `no-new-privileges:true`).
- Docker `json-file` log rotation (`max-size: 10m`, `max-file: 3`) and `on-failure` restart policies (`MaximumRetryCount: 3`).
- Automatic port detection scans `Dockerfile` (`EXPOSE`, `ENV PORT`), `nginx.conf` (`listen`), and Docker image `ExposedPorts`.
- **Free Tier Idle Hibernation**: Free-tier containers sleep after 30 minutes of inactivity to preserve host compute; paid tiers run 24/7 uninterrupted.
- **Deployment Concurrency Locks**: Atomic Redis locks prevent overlapping builds per project (`409 Conflict`).

---

## 2. Compute Tiers, Quotas & Pricing

1 Credit = ₹1.60 INR ($0.02 USD).

| Tier | Credits / Month | Monthly Price | RAM | vCPU | Storage | Max Projects | Uptime Policy | Custom Domains | Daily Builds | Build Sandbox |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `free` | 0 | ₹0 (Forever) | 128 MB | 0.5 | 1 GB | 1 (+1 slot / 25 cr) | Sleeps after 30m idle | `.code-host.online` only | 10 / day | 512 MB RAM, 3m timeout |
| `basic` | 50 | ₹80 ($1.00) | 256 MB | 1.0 | 2 GB | 3 | 24/7 Always-On | Included (Free TLS) | Unlimited | 2 GB RAM, 10m timeout |
| `pro` | 150 | ₹240 ($3.00) | 512 MB | 2.0 | 5 GB | 5 | 24/7 Always-On | Included (Free TLS) | Unlimited | 2 GB RAM, 10m timeout |
| `business` | 400 | ₹640 ($8.00) | 1024 MB | 4.0 | 10 GB | 10 | 24/7 Always-On | Included (Free TLS) | Unlimited | 2 GB RAM, 10m timeout |
| Hackathon Pass | +50 bonus | ₹49 (72h one-time) | 512 MB | 2.0 | 5 GB | Up to 5 | 24/7 Always-On | Included (Free TLS) | Unlimited | 2 GB RAM, 10m timeout |

### Credit Top-Up Bundles
- **Starter**: 50 credits — ₹80 ($1.00)
- **Developer**: 100 credits — ₹160 ($2.00)
- **Team**: 300 credits — ₹400 ($5.00, 17% savings)
- **Pro Scale**: 600 credits — ₹720 ($9.00, 25% savings)
- **Custom Amount**: Any amount starting from 10 credits (₹16).
- **Server Slot Unlock**: Spend 25 credits to permanently increase `serverLimit` by +1 from the dashboard (`POST /billing/unlock-slot`).

## 3. REST API Reference (`https://api.code-host.online`)

All authenticated endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>`.

- `POST /auth/login` — Body: `{ identifier, password }` -> `{ accessToken, refreshToken, user }`
- `POST /auth/refresh` — Body: `{ refreshToken }` -> Rotates session tokens (`accessToken`, `refreshToken`).
- `GET /auth/me` — Returns current authenticated user profile and `serverLimit`.
- `POST /auth/mcp-token` — Issues a 30-day JWT for headless MCP AI agent clients.
- `POST /auth/change-password` — Body: `{ currentPassword?, newPassword }` -> Updates password, increments `tokenVersion`, and returns fresh tokens.
- `POST /auth/logout` — Revokes active JWT `jti` and deletes the refresh session.
- `GET /projects` — List projects belonging to the user.
- `POST /projects` — Body: `{ name, tier }` -> Creates a project (validates `serverLimit` and atomically deducts tier credits if paid).
- `GET /projects/:id` — Fetch single project details.
- `PUT /projects/:id` — Update `name`, `buildCommand`, `startCommand`, `dockerfileOverride`, `envVars`, `tier`, or `customDomain` (paid tiers only).
- `POST /projects/:id/restart` | `POST /projects/:id/stop` | `POST /projects/:id/redeploy` — Control container lifecycle.
- `GET /projects/:id/logs` — Retrieve recent container logs.
- `DELETE /projects/:id` — Stop container and delete project.
- `POST /deployments/:projectId` — Multipart upload of `.zip` archive (`code` field, max 50MB).
- `POST /deployments/:projectId/github` — Body: `{ repoUrl, branch, subdir? }` -> Clones public GitHub repository and deploys.
- `GET /deployments/:projectId` — List latest 10 deployments and status.
- `POST /files/:projectId` — Body: `{ filePath, content }` -> Write source file directly into project workspace.
- `POST /files/:projectId/deploy` — Build and deploy directly from files written in project workspace.
- `GET /billing/wallet` | `GET /billing/tiers` | `POST /billing/unlock-slot` | `POST /billing/razorpay/verify` — Check credits, tiers, verify Razorpay orders, and unlock slots.

---

## 4. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

CodeHost exposes a native **Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP Server** so LLMs and coding agents can write code, deploy applications, read build/runtime logs, and manage live services autonomously.

### Connection Details
- **Discovery (`GET`)**: `https://api.code-host.online/mcp`
- **RPC Endpoint (`POST`)**: `https://api.code-host.online/mcp` (alias: `https://api.code-host.online/api/mcp`)
- **Protocol Version**: `2024-11-05`
- **Headers**:
  - `Content-Type: application/json`
  - `Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>` (optional if calling `codehost_login` first and passing `token` in tool arguments)

### Example MCP Client Configuration
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "codehost": {
      "url": "https://api.code-host.online/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_CODEHOST_JWT_TOKEN"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Supported JSON-RPC Methods
- `initialize`
- `notifications/initialized`
- `ping`
- `resources/list`
- `resources/read` (`codehost://docs/overview`, `codehost://config/tiers`)
- `tools/list`
- `tools/call`

### Available MCP Tools & Input Schemas

1. **`codehost_login`**
   - Authenticate with CodeHost email/username and password to obtain a JWT token.
   - Schema: `{ identifier: string, password: string }` (required: `identifier`, `password`)
2. **`list_projects`**
   - List all projects owned by the authenticated user along with status, tier, and live URL.
   - Schema: `{ token?: string }`
3. **`get_project`**
   - Fetch detailed configuration and the 5 most recent deployments for a project.
   - Schema: `{ projectId: string, token?: string }` (required: `projectId`)
4. **`create_project`**
   - Create a new cloud project/subdomain (`3-50` lowercase alphanumeric/dash characters).
   - Schema: `{ name: string, tier?: "free" | "basic" | "pro" | "business", buildCommand?: string, startCommand?: string, envVars?: Record<string, string>, token?: string }` (required: `name`)
5. **`deploy_github`**
   - Deploy a public GitHub repository (`https://github.com/owner/repo`) into an existing project.
   - Schema: `{ projectId: string, repoUrl: string, branch?: string, subdir?: string, token?: string }` (required: `projectId`, `repoUrl`)
6. **`write_project_files`**
   - Write one or more source code files (e.g., `package.json`, `server.js`, `app.py`, `Dockerfile`) directly into a project's workspace before calling `deploy_files`.
   - Schema: `{ projectId: string, files: Array<{ path: string, content: string }>, token?: string }` (required: `projectId`, `files`)
7. **`deploy_files`**
   - Trigger a Docker build and start the container from files currently saved in the project's workspace.
   - Schema: `{ projectId: string, token?: string }` (required: `projectId`)
8. **`get_project_logs`**
   - Read live container stdout/stderr logs and the latest deployment build status/logs.
   - Schema: `{ projectId: string, tail?: number, token?: string }` (required: `projectId`)
9. **`control_project`**
   - Start/restart, stop, redeploy, or delete a project.
   - Schema: `{ projectId: string, action: "restart" | "stop" | "redeploy" | "delete", token?: string }` (required: `projectId`, `action`)
10. **`get_wallet_and_tiers`**
    - Retrieve current wallet credit balance, account `serverLimit`, and full resource tier/credit package definitions.
    - Schema: `{ token?: string }`
